# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

only the latest [stable](https://github.com/namidaco/namida/releases/latest) and the latest [beta](https://github.com/namidaco/namida-snapshots/releases/latest) get security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

found a security issue (like a way to access someone's library, account or device through namida)? please **don't** open a public issue for it.

- report it privately [here](https://github.com/namidaco/namida/security/advisories/new)
- or email **namida.coo@gmail.com**

tell me what's affected, how to reproduce it and what an attacker could do with it. i'll get back to you asap 🤎
